question: In 10 years, Alex will be 2 times Alex's current age. How old is Alex now?
distractor_rationale: divided the years by the multiplier itself instead of by (multiplier − 1) — forgets that the given years only cover the EXTRA part of the growth, not the whole multiple
added the multiplier to the years instead of using it as a multiplier — treats the relationship like an additive comparison, not a multiplicative one
subtracted the multiplier from the years instead of solving the proportional relationship
solution_steps: Let Alex's age now be a. In 10 years, Alex will be a + 10, and that equals 2 × a. So a + 10 = 2a, which means 10 = a × (2 − 1), so a = 10 ÷ 1 = 10.
